title: review: G3: bounded tool outputs with an expansion path — tests-green prints one line on pass and keeps the log on fail, review and spec-review prompts get a summary-first bounded diff, recall shows provenance and freshness
spec:
Depends on G2 (T-0266, spawn.packet). Scout T-0262: review.md inserts {{diff}} raw with no size guard and spec-review.md inserts {{code}} the same way (spawn.render about line 70); tests-green.sh prints nothing on pass and up to 40 filtered lines on fail then deletes its log; recall.py prints hits with a date but no provenance column or age.
Change:
1. .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh: on pass print exactly one stderr line 'tests-green: OK <N tests> <HEAD sha 7> <seconds>s' (N parsed from the runner output, '-' when unknown); on fail keep the failures-only block (at most 40 lines) and keep the full log at .orchestrator/runs/tests/<task-or-dir>-<ts>.log, printing its path as the last line; TESTS_GREEN_DRY behaviour unchanged.
2. spawn.bounded_diff(diff_text, cap_chars=12000, expand_hint) returns the diffstat summary first, then hunks up to the cap, then one line '<N> more lines; expand with: <expand_hint>'; spawn.bounded_text(text, cap_chars, expand_hint) for other blobs. Review and spec-review rendering pass {{diff}} and {{code}} through these with the hint naming the git command in the worktree. Caps configurable via pool.toml [limits] review_diff_chars (default 12000) and spec_review_code_chars (default 8000).
3. .claude/skills/memory/scripts/recall.py: every hit line carries provenance (mem, bus, graph) and an age in days ('3d'); output capped at [limits].recall_hits (default 30) with a final line naming how many more hits exist and the command to see them.
4. README Pipeline: a 'Bounded outputs' paragraph listing the bounds and how to expand each (git diff command, log path, recall flags); mention bus_events(since) as the delta path for bus state.
Tests: tests/test_spawn.py::test_bounded_diff_summary_first, ::test_bounded_diff_expansion_hint, ::test_review_prompt_diff_is_bounded; tests/test_tests_green.py (new): run the hook against a scratch repo with a passing unittest and a failing one, assert the OK line shape and the log path line.
acceptance: tests/test_tests_green.py passes for both the pass and the fail shape
recall.py output shows provenance and age per hit and caps at [limits].recall_hits
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

comments.issue: bounded_diff duplicates every hunk header line. When a line starts with '@@', it is appended to `hunks` inside the elif branch, but the trailing unconditional `if line.startswith((...,'@@',...))` also matches and appends the same line to `current`, which later gets flushed into `hunks` too. Verified by running bounded_diff on a 1-hunk diff: output contains '@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@' twice in a row. Every hunk header in every reviewed diff will be duplicated, corrupting the diff shown to the review/spec-review models.

render() unconditionally re-runs bounded_diff on the 'diff' kwarg even though both call sites (review and spec-review construction, further down in this file) already pass a pre-bounded string (scoped_diff/code_excerpts wrapped in bounded_diff/bounded_text). Since render() never receives the '_diff_cap'/'_diff_hint' kwargs, it falls back to generic cap=12000/hint='git diff', discarding the correct worktree+scope-specific expand hint computed by the caller, and re-parses the diffstat-prefixed text as if it were a raw diff. Combined with the bug above, this compounds: verified that piping an already-bounded diff through bounded_diff again duplicates the '@@' header a second time (4 copies total for a single hunk). This directly corrupts the bounded diff shown to reviewers, undermining the security-relevant review path for complexity>=7 tasks.

Acceptance criteria require tests/test_spawn.py::test_bounded_diff_summary_first, ::test_bounded_diff_expansion_hint, and ::test_review_prompt_diff_is_bounded to pass, but the diff contains no changes to tests/test_spawn.py at all — these tests do not exist in the file (confirmed: grep for these names and for 'bounded_diff' in tests/test_spawn.py returns nothing). This acceptance criterion cannot pass as submitted, and the missing tests are exactly what would have caught the duplicate-'@@'-line bug above.
